explication: ClewdR is a single-binary proxy that exposes Claude.ai and Claude Code through native Claude and OpenAI-compatible APIs, with an authenticated web admin UI for cookie and configuration management. The main request path runs from an API client through server routing and Claude handling to the upstream Claude service; cookie selection and protocol conversion support that flow. The README documents endpoint and admin capabilities, while sampled sources show selected state, auth, and UI behavior. Some runtime links are therefore left unverified rather than inferred from module names.
